name: Litopys
description: The story record of each chat, shown in the Library. A worker cuts the story into scenes and, for each closed scene, writes one chapter (what changed, not a retelling) and the durable facts that came with it into data/litopys/chats/<chat>.json; older chapters can merge into arcs. Before each reply it adds one block of chapters and facts within a token budget, and the messages it holds leave the prompt. Old Memory and Litopys 1.x data are carried over once. Formerly Archivarius.
